chunks.rationale: Start with electron/test/spec-tasks.test.js (the checkbox DAG contract: ids, needs:, cycles, waves), then spec-mode.test.js dispatch/converge (crew sync, wave-1 fork, wave-2 after complete), then spec-ipc.test.js (N worker runs vs one converge run), then test/specCard.test.tsx (Dispatch/Converge only at build).
risks: Wave-2 is asserted inside the wave-1 test after completeCrewTask — easy to miss if a later edit splits the case.
IPC dispatch test writes tasks.md into the project checkout (no worktree on the spec thread fixture).

chunks.rationale: electron/specTasks.js is the format. electron/services.js dispatchSpec/syncSpecCrewFromParsed/forkSpecWave is the live path: parse → addCrewTasks (needs remapped to tN) → claim one orchWorker per open unblocked task. ipc.js threads:dispatchSpec starts those runs; threads:convergeSpec starts one run on the spec thread.
risks: Crew sync matches by collapsed title. Two checkboxes with the same title collide; the second is treated as already added.
sourceToCrew precomputes tN the same way addCrewTasks does. If addCrewTasks ever changes id assignment, remapped needs silently point at the wrong task.
Dispatch is fail-closed on parse errors (cycle, unknown needs) — a typo in tasks.md blocks the whole wave, not just the bad line.
Next wave is not auto-started when workers finish. The human (or a later Dispatch click) has to come back. Crew claim still holds the DAG.
Workers land in their own worktrees (forkWorkerThread default). Ticking tasks.md there does not update the spec thread's copy; the crew list is the source of truth.

chunks.rationale: UI is SpecCard at stage===build: Dispatch (permissionAllow) and Converge (btn). Wired through ipc.ts, preload, wireClient, useCoder, App, fakeCoder, devCoder. Approving tasks.md still starts a run, but the build prompt now tells the parent to orchestrate instead of implementing the checklist itself.
risks: Changing the build-stage prompt is a behavior change for anyone who approved tasks.md expecting the old 'implement it yourself' turn.
useCoder.dispatchSpec only patches the source thread; new workers appear via the threads:changed broadcast that IPC already sends.

chunks.rationale: SPEC_GOAL.tasks now documents the checkbox + needs: <id> format so newly written tasks.md is dispatchable. src/devCoder.ts dropped the 'out of scope' line.
risks: Existing tasks.md files written before this change have no needs: annotations — they still parse (document-order ids, one big wave).
No MCP spec_dispatch/spec_converge tools — agents on the spec thread cannot trigger these without the card. Deliberate: issue asked for IPC + spec card, same seam as startSpec/reviewSpec.
No runner hook to dispatch the next wave when the last worker of the current wave completes.
